gloss: desk work; office duty; indoor work

definitions.gloss: desk work; office duty; indoor work
definitions.explanation: Work performed inside the office, as opposed to fieldwork or outside sales. Also refers to a person assigned to such duties.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{内勤|ないきん}の{日|ひ}だ。
examples.english: Today is a desk work day.

examples.japanese: {内勤|ないきん}から{外回|そとまわ}りに{異動|いどう}になった。
examples.english: I was transferred from office duty to outside sales.

examples.japanese: {内勤|ないきん}が{中心|ちゅうしん}なので、{運動不足|うんどうぶそく}になりがちだ。
examples.english: Since my work is mostly at a desk, I tend to not get enough exercise.

notes:
Used in workplace contexts to distinguish between people who work at their desks in the office and those who go out to meet clients or do fieldwork. Can function as a noun modifier: {内勤|ないきん}の{社員|しゃいん} (office-based employees).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内勤|ないきん}の{仕事|しごと}: desk/office work
- {内勤|ないきん}{社員|しゃいん}: office-based employee
- {内勤|ないきん}に{異動|いどう}する: to be transferred to office duty

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {外勤|がいきん}: outside work, fieldwork — the direct opposite of {内勤|ないきん}
- {外回|そとまわ}り: outside rounds, visiting clients — similar to {外勤|がいきん} but more colloquial
- デスクワーク: desk work — loanword, used more casually and not specific to job classification
